'''Duanna Falos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who had a reputation for being a fearless hunter. At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, Falos traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Durace]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] along with her lover, her [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] and her [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] servant, because she wanted to test her skills by hunting the planet's beasts. On arrival on the world, she hired a group of agents to take her and her party on a hunt, but as their expedition progressed, the group experienced a series of accidents and the agents realized that one of Falos' associates was trying to [[Death/Legends|kill]] her.<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
